scenario: 取消订单并带原因 — leaf, path param + reason body, dry-run first
input: 取消订单 555666，原因写买家主动申请取消

semantic_rubric: order_id 555666 via --params (path); reason carried in --data with the user's wording (买家主动申请)
safety: --dry-run first (destructive), restates which order will be cancelled
cancels the ORDER — does not confuse with fulfillments cancel

notes: POST /orders/{order_id}/cancel; body reason is optional but the user supplied one.

scenario: 查订单支付流水 — orders transactions, 不是 billing transactions
input: 查一下订单 778877 的支付交易流水

semantic_rubric: orders transactions list = buyer payment events on an order; billing transactions = app charges to the merchant — must pick the former
any jq extraction starts at .data, without -r

notes: GET /orders/{order_id}/transactions. Cross-domain lookalike with billing transactions.

scenario: 人工标记欺诈风险 — risks create, level 枚举取 high
input: 订单 909090 看起来像欺诈单，帮我标记成高风险，理由写 IP 和收货地址不一致

semantic_rubric: 高风险 → risk.level high (enum low/medium/high), nested under the required risk object
the stated reason (IP 和收货地址不一致) goes into the details array
restates (or --dry-run) before writing the risk record

scenario: 运单号识别承运商 — detect, 只读
input: 运单号 1Z999AA10123456784 是哪家承运商的？

semantic_rubric: uses tracking-carriers detect (query param tracking_number), not list + manual matching
read-only — answers directly from .data, nothing fabricated
